_about: Per real-vehicle preset: the research entry it draws on, the layout it maps to, the synthesizer's modelling choices (sound character, not specifications), and estimates for anything the research left null, each with its reason in _why. scripts/build-real-presets.py turns this and research/*.json into the presets in engine-data.json. Facts derived from geometry rather than a source are noted as such (a single-crankpin 45-degree V-twin must fire 315/405; an odd-cylinder radial fires every other cylinder).

presets._scRatioSource: Measured, not published: Gran Turismo 7's recording of the Hellcat (and its intake microphone above all) has the twin-screw whine at 11.6x crank speed, the 5-lobe twin-screw model's lobe factor times 2.32. It was 2.4, which put the whine exactly on the V8's 12th order.

presets.label: Buick Regal GNX (1987, automatic)
